primary_asset_observations.source: For each semantic_group, take each string in semantic_group.observations[] verbatim and attach it to that group's primary_asset.

primary_asset_inference.source: Take semantic_group.inference verbatim and attach it to that group's primary_asset.

secondary_asset_coverage.source: For every secondary asset explicitly listed in group_asset_assignment, create exactly one GPT-authored coverage observation using the template below.
secondary_asset_coverage.observed_value_template: This image is an alternate source view of the same {working_name} design composition represented by {group_key}; it confirms the asset belongs to the same product/design reference.

reference_synthesis.source: Take semantic_group.synthesis verbatim as exactly one synthesis assertion for that group.
reference_synthesis.source_provenance_rule: Link the synthesis assertion to every canonical image_visual_observation materialized for the same group by this completion spec, including the primary observations, primary inference, and secondary alternate-view coverage rows.

counts_expected_from_materialization.note: Observation-row count is deterministic from the original semantic_group observations plus one inference per group plus one alternate-view coverage row per secondary asset. Codex must compute and report the exact count before applying and prove the same count on replay.
